%% Axis limits are generated by step3_export_data.R from the current grid.
\psset{xunit=0.061in,yunit=1.3in}
\begin{pspicture}(15,0.0)(85,2.6)

  %% Heatmap cells (R-generated colored rectangles)
  \input{data/panel_B1_heatmap_cells}

  %% Optimum marker
  \rput(\optX,\optY){\textsf{\scriptsize $\GShat$}}
  \rput(50,0.30103){\textsf{\scriptsize $U(0,1)$}} %% uniform regime: kappa = 2

  %% Axes overlay
  \psaxes[Ox=20,Oy=0,Dx=10,Dy=0.5,ticksize=-3pt 0,
          subticks=0,labelsep=4pt,
          labels=y, %keep only y-axis labels
          axesstyle=frame,linecolor=borderGrey]{-}%
          (\panelCxmin,\panelCymin)(\panelCxmax,\panelCymax)

  % Custom x labels (0.2 to 0.7 by 0.1)
  \uput[d](23,-0.1){\textsf{\small 0.2}}
  \uput[d](33,-0.1){\textsf{\small 0.3}}
  \uput[d](43,-0.1){\textsf{\small 0.4}}
  \uput[d](53,-0.1){\textsf{\small 0.5}}
  \uput[d](63,-0.1){\textsf{\small 0.6}}
  \uput[d](73,-0.1){\textsf{\small 0.7}}

  %% Axis labels
  \rput[t](50,-0.3){\textsf{\small $m$ (mean of $G$, $\SGPc/100$)}}
  \rput[b]{90}(17.5,1.30){\textsf{\small $\log_{10}(\kappa)$}}

  %% Color legend annotation
  \rput[tr](72,\panelCymax){%
    \raisebox{-20pt}{\textsf{\scriptsize\textcolor{subtitleGrey}{Color $=\log_{10}$ distance}}}}
